sentences.text: Reviews describe Acinetobacter baumannii as a Gram-negative opportunistic bacterium of the ESKAPE group and a leading cause of healthcare-associated infections.
Reviews describe it as having moved from a relatively obscure environmental bacterium to a globally recognised multidrug-resistant pathogen, prominent in intensive care units.
It forms robust biofilms and survives in a desiccated state for months, which drives its persistence in the hospital-built environment.
Reported infections include ventilator-associated pneumonia, bloodstream infections, urinary tract infections and wound infections.
It is listed as a critical priority pathogen, with carbapenem-resistant strains endemic on several continents.
